x-draft: ADR-0035 (proposed): written by homelabnext.novelty (hnx novelty run) and read by its corroborate; not frozen until ADR-0035 is accepted
title: Novelty Finding
description: An advisory behavioural-novelty finding (ADR-0035 decision 6; docs/novelty.md): the platform's own table in the OCSF conventions of this directory, not an OCSF class (ocsf_class_uid 0 is OCSF's base event). Every row is heuristic: no deterministic gate escalates on one alone. Written by the lake novelty analyzer and, in the same shape, by host-kernel sensors with their own source.

uid.description: Deterministic id: a digest of the source, the profile's spec, as_of, status, entity and value. The idempotency (content) key of the table.

time.description: When the finding was made: its as_of for the lake analyzer, the sensor's own observation time for a host source. RFC 3339 with an explicit offset; stored as UTC.

as_of.description: The instant the run scored up to (the end of the scoring window).

source.description: What produced the finding: lake-novelty for the lake analyzer, a host sensor's own name otherwise. corroborate counts distinct sources.

source_kind.description: Always heuristic: a novelty finding is advisory (ADR-0035 decision 6).

profile.description: The spec profile (or the host sensor's baseline) that produced the finding.

entity.description: The entity's value as text (a string as is, anything else as JSON).

entity_column.description: The column path the entity came from.

value.description: The value as text: the one value, or a JSON array when the profile has several value columns. Absent for a high-cardinality row.

value_columns.description: The column paths the value came from.

status.description: finding: scored at or above emit_at; unlearned: the entity has no learned support, so no score; high_cardinality: the entity has more distinct learned values than the profile allows, reported once and not scored.

score.description: surprise x confidence; absent unless status is finding.

confidence.description: min(1, entity_total / entity_min_samples); absent unless status is finding.

support.description: Decayed support s(entity, value) in the learning window.

entity_total.description: Decayed entity total T(entity) over all its values in the learning window.

count.description: Rows of (entity, value) in the scoring window.

learn_until.description: End of the learning window (exclusive) = start of the scoring window.

score_until.description: End of the scoring window (exclusive) = as_of.

spec_digest.description: sha256 of the profile's canonical spec, so a finding names the parameters that produced it.

message.description: One line: what is new, for whom, and the arithmetic.

reasons.description: The terms of the decision, one per entry (support, total, surprise, confidence, threshold).

tlp.description: The row's TLP 2.0 label (ADR-0033 decision 5): the strictest label among the rows that produced the finding, its learning-window rows included (ADR-0035 decision 5). The lake refuses a row without one.
